_about: One row per new Bloodborne item. Values are read at setup from the player's own games: 'lop:' = Lies of P asset/text, 'bb:' = Bloodborne template row copied then changed. fit: how the Lies of P model is placed in the Hunter's hand (blade-z: Unreal Z blade axis to Bloodborne -Y, handle at origin; forearm-gun: only the keepBones part of the Legion arm, barrel to -Z, stock up +Y). keepBones: bone names whose vertices are kept. tex*: Lies of P textures (BaseColor, AO/Roughness/Metal, Normal), size: largest edge in Bloodborne. shopQwc: one bath-shop row per value; the row shows once that unlock flag is on (-1 = no flag; 12101004 = Sword Hunter Badge, verifying which the shop honours for weapons). blade-z turns the Lies of P blade half a turn so its edge faces forward. Second UV set = gap-free unwrap for blood; vertex colours copied from the template. wepmotionCategory: the new moveset number (a160/a161, registered in the Hunter's behaviour and animation lists); wepmotionBothHandId stays the template weapon's (22 Holy Moonlight Sword, 29 Hunter Blunderbuss), because the game has no two-handed moveset for invented numbers (a 2026-11-10 check: Cataclysm on 161/61 never fired, a copy on 129/28 did); residentSpEffectId -1 drops the template's passive effect (the Holy Moonlight Sword's moonlight glow). gripShift (m, blade-z): the hand sits that much further up the handle toward the trigger; gripTilt (degrees): the blade tilts about the hand toward the shoulder in the carry pose (creator 2026-11-10: sword floated above the shoulder, hand too far from the trigger). 2026-11-10 (0.3.0): Cataclysm uses the Church/Repeating pistol moveset 129 with two-hand id 28, exactly as the 'Cataclysm check' copy that fired (creator: do what the check does); its Lies of P moves (a161) stay on a test copy in the shop. Pale Knight's two-hand id is 2 (its one-hand set), so the transformed form keeps the one-handed hold (creator: transformed must look the same, only the twirl and glow show the change). formBDummy: the Hunter's hold point for the transformed form (dmypolyId_Slot2RightFormB; 300 = the normal form's hold, so the transformed Pale Knight sits exactly as the normal one; -1 keeps the template's). gripTilt lowered to 5 (creator: hold it straighter to shoot). 2026-11-10: the Lies of P Cataclysm (161/28) worked perfectly in the creator's test, so it is the real one now. fit lop-hand: placed exactly where it sits on Pino's left hand/forearm in Lies of P, expressed in the Hunter's left weapon bone, so Lies of P's firing moves aim it as in Lies of P. iconFrom: the Lies of P item picture made into the Bloodborne menu icon iconId (menu_knowledge_<iconId>, same size/format as iconTemplate's) (creator 2026-11-10). 0.3.2 test: icons on new numbers (9600/9700) never showed, so they use icon files the game ships but no item uses (2116, 2117; found with the freeicons check). 0.3.5 (creator's 0.3.4 test: Cataclysm faced backwards toward the Hunter's back; it should slide over the left forearm like the Legion arm): fit forearm-sleeve lays Pino's forearm (elbow->wrist, bind pose) along the Hunter's left forearm (rest pose), elbow on elbow, scaled to the Hunter's forearm, roll matched by the back of the arm; sleeveRoll (degrees) turns it about the forearm if the check picture shows it twisted. Checked with the armfit picture before shipping. attachDummy: the Hunter body model's attach point the game hangs this weapon on (EquipParamWeapon dmypolyId_Slot0LeftFormA of the template: 345 for a left-hand gun). Its frame is turned 131 deg from the L_Weapon bone (measured with dummyvsbone; right-hand 300 equals R_Weapon within 0.3 deg), which is why 0.3.2-0.3.4 Cataclysm faced backwards. The model is placed in that point's frame. 0 = the weapon bone's frame (right hand).
